q1.explanationZh: employ 及物动词“雇用；使用”，名词 employee“雇员”、employer“雇主”。

q2.explanationZh: employ 加 -ee 表示“被……的人”，employee“雇员”。

q3.explanationZh: employ 加 -er 表示“做……的人”，employer“雇主”。

q4.explanationZh: emperor“皇帝”的女性形式是 empress“皇后；女皇”。

q5.explanationZh: empty 作形容词“空的”，作动词“使空；倒空”。

q6.explanationZh: en- 加形容词 able 构成动词 enable“使能够”。

q7.explanationZh: en- 加 close 构成 enclose“围住；附入”。

q8.explanationZh: encounter 动词“意外遇见；遭到”，名词“邂逅；遭遇”。

q9.explanationZh: en- 加 courage“勇气”构成 encourage“鼓励”。

q10.explanationZh: end 名词“末端；结束”，动词“结束”。

q12.explanationZh: endure 去 e 加 -ance 构成名词 endurance“耐力”。

q13.explanationZh: endure“忍受；持久”，常用于否定句 can’t endure。

q15.explanationZh: energy 的形容词 energetic“精力充沛的”。

q16.explanationZh: energise（英式）与 energize（美式）都对，意为“使有活力”。

q18.explanationZh: engage 义项多：“吸引；使从事；使订婚”，be engaged in“从事”。

q20.explanationZh: engine 加 -er 表示人，engineer“工程师”。

q21.explanationZh: engineer 加 -ing 构成 engineering“工程（学）”。

q22.explanationZh: English 首字母大写，既是形容词“英国的；英语的”，也是名词“英语”。

q23.explanationZh: enhance“增强；提高”，enhance one’s chances“增加机会”。

q24.explanationZh: enjoy“喜爱；享受”，后接名词或动名词。

q25.explanationZh: enjoy 加 -able 构成形容词 enjoyable“令人愉快的”。

q26.explanationZh: en- 加 large 构成动词 enlarge“扩大”。

q28.explanationZh: enough“足够的”，修饰形容词时放在其后：strong enough。

q29.explanationZh: enrol 是英式拼写，enroll 是美式拼写，都对。

q31.explanationZh: enter“进入”，直接接宾语，不说 enter into the room。

q32.explanationZh: enterprise“企业”，small and medium-sized enterprises“中小企业”。

q33.explanationZh: entertain“使快乐；招待”，名词 entertainment“娱乐”。

q34.explanationZh: entertain 加 -er 表示人，entertainer“表演者”。

q35.explanationZh: entertaining“有趣的”，形容事物令人愉快。

q36.explanationZh: enable sb. to do sth.“使某人能够做某事”。

q37.explanationZh: encourage sb. to do sth.“鼓励某人做某事”，to 后接动词原形。

q38.explanationZh: end in“以……告终”，如 end in failure。

q39.explanationZh: end up“最终（成为、到达）”，end up in failure“以失败告终”。

q40.explanationZh: be engaged in sth.“从事；忙于”，介词用 in。

q41.explanationZh: be engaged to sb.“与某人订婚”，介词用 to。

q42.explanationZh: be engaged 也可指电话“占线”。

accept: enjoy oneself (= have a good time)

q43.explanationZh: enjoy oneself = have a good time“玩得开心”，oneself 随主语变化。

q44.explanationZh: enjoy 后接名词或动名词，不接不定式：enjoy doing sth.。

q46.explanationZh: enlarge sth.“扩大某物”，如 enlarge your vocabulary。

accept: enough for sb. to do sth.

q47.explanationZh: enough for sb. to do sth.“足够某人做某事”。

q49.explanationZh: enter for“报名参加（比赛、考试）”。

q50.explanationZh: energise sb. for work“激励某人努力工作”，energise 也可写作 energize。

q51.explanationZh: 主语 the firm 是第三人称单数，一般现在时用 employs“雇用”。

q52.explanationZh: was 后接形容词作表语，empty“空的”。

q53.explanationZh: can’t 后接动词原形，endure“坚持；持久”。

q54.explanationZh: enable sb. to do sth.“使某人能够做某事”，叙述过去用 enabled。

q55.explanationZh: no sooner ... than ... 中 than 后用一般过去时，encountered“偶遇”。

q56.explanationZh: at the end of“在……的尽头”。

q57.explanationZh: have been doing 现在完成进行时，enjoy reputation“享有声誉”，用 enjoying。

q58.explanationZh: an 后接可数名词单数，work as an engineer“当工程师”。

q59.explanationZh: had 后接过去分词构成过去完成时，enter the hall“进入大厅”，用 entered。

q60.explanationZh: will 后接动词原形，encourage“鼓励”。

q61.sampleAnswer: The biggest threat to endangered wildlife is the loss of their natural habitats due to human activities.
references: The biggest threat to endangered wildlife is the loss of their natural habitats due to human activities.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “濒危野生动物”= endangered wildlife；“由于”可用 due to。

q62.sampleAnswer: Any attempt for Taiwan to break away from our motherland will end up in failure.
references: Any attempt for Taiwan to break away from our motherland will end up in failure.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “以失败告终”= end up in failure；“分离出去”= break away from。

q63.sampleAnswer: The more enjoyable and rewarding an activity is, the more likely we are to do it repeatedly.
references: The more enjoyable and rewarding an activity is, the more likely we are to do it repeatedly.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “越……就越……”用 the more ..., the more ...；“令人愉悦的”= enjoyable。

q64.sampleAnswer: Young people usually have more energy than the old.
references: Young people usually have more energy than the old.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “有活力”= have energy，比较用 more energy than；the old 表示“老年人”。

q65.sampleAnswer: They never learned skills to engage the attention of others.
references: They never learned skills to engage the attention of others.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: engage the attention of others“吸引他人注意”，不定式作定语修饰 skills。

q66.sampleAnswer: He decided to enrol(l) in the history course at the local evening school.
references: He decided to enrol(l) in the history course at the local evening school.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “注册学习某课程”= enrol(l) in a course；decide to do sth.。

q67.sampleAnswer: Passing the English examination will enhance your chances of getting the job.
references: Passing the English examination will enhance your chances of getting the job.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: 动名词短语 passing the exam 作主语；enhance one’s chances“增加机会”。

q68.sampleAnswer: There seems to be something wrong with the engine. It’s much better to call in a mechanic to check it thoroughly than to fix it yourself.
references: There seems to be something wrong with the engine. It’s much better to call in a mechanic to check it thoroughly than to fix it yourself.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “……出了问题”= there is something wrong with ...；“请来”= call in；It’s better to do ... than to do ...。

q69.sampleAnswer: We’re enlarging the production scale to produce more and better computers.
references: We’re enlarging the production scale to produce more and better computers.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “正在扩充”用现在进行时 are enlarging；不定式表目的。

q70.sampleAnswer: The shop owner ensured that all the goods in his shop were of good quality.
references: The shop owner ensured that all the goods in his shop were of good quality.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: ensure that ...“保证……”；“质量好”= be of good quality。
